verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only pull-based data export. The Raw Event Export API returns events as JSONL and is recommended for high-volume exports, and the Engage API exports profiles, so a developer could build their own pipeline to forward data to third parties. The integrations directory and warehouse connectors describe data flowing INTO Mixpanel (Census, Vendo, warehouse sync), not native outbound streaming. Missing for 10: native outbound event streaming or forwarding, prebuilt destination connectors for CRMs and ad platforms, outbound webhooks, real-time delivery, independent corroboration.
